facts.text: Under the FDU Promise and Latino Promise pathways, students spend their first two years taking courses toward their major to complete an associate degree before transitioning to a bachelor's degree.

sources.title: FDU Promise/Latino Promise - Fairleigh Dickinson University
sources.quote: Students spend their first two years with FDU Promise/Latino Promise, taking courses toward their intended major and then easily transitioning to the Bachelor's degree once they have completed their Associate's degree.
